newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks quiet in London, await FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks quiet in London, await FOMC.

text.p: Trading in Hong Kong stocks in London was quiet on Friday ahead of Tuesday's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting, traders said.
"There's not a lot happening," said one trader.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 7.64 points at 11,600, after the Hang Seng in Hong Kong rose 5.68 points to 11,592.36.

HSBC shares were squeezed 85 HK cents higher to HK$142.35, in line with a gain in the London shares, giving the market its biggest boost of the day. But there was selling of Amoy Properties shares on the back of poor results.

Company results announcements next week and Tuesday's U.S. interest rate policy meeting are expected to affect the market next week. "The market will start quiet ahead of the federal reserve meeting," said a trader.
